requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMBs
requirements.Description: Develop HP's first business ink tank printer specifically targeting unmanaged to lightly managed SMBs (5-250 employees, 6-15 printers, AMPV ~500 pages).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses a gap in HP's portfolio and targets a new, high-value SMB segment for growth and competitive defense.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: A new ink tank printer model is designed, manufactured, and available for SMB customers as defined.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO
requirements.Description: Deliver the lowest total cost of ownership (TCO) in HP's business printer portfolio for the SMB segment.
requirements.Rationale: SMB customers are highly sensitive to ROI and operational costs; this is a key differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMBs
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Validated TCO calculations show Magellan is lower than all other HP business printers for defined SMB use cases.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity Solutions – Print, Scan, Support
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity features for print, scan, and support workflows, including Perfect Print and Perfect Scan.
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates Magellan with superior productivity and manageability for non-IT managed SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMBs
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features (Perfect Print/Scan, support) are functional, tested, and deliver measurable productivity improvements over baseline.

requirements.Title: SMB Device Management Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal tailored for SMBs to manage multiple printers (6-15 typical), supporting device management, setup, usage monitoring, and support.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT; a simple, consolidated portal enables efficient management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is operational, supports multi-device management, and is validated by SMB user testing.

requirements.Title: Maintenance-Free or Reduced Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Design the printer to be maintenance-free or require significantly less maintenance (fewer parts to replace over life).
requirements.Rationale: Reduces operational burden for SMBs with limited IT resources, lowers TCO, and improves customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMBs
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance intervals and parts replacement frequency are demonstrably lower than comparable models; user documentation reflects this.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer is manufactured with at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s sustainability goals and is a competitive differentiator for environmentally conscious SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMBs
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Material composition is validated by third-party sustainability standards; product marketing claims are substantiated.

requirements.Title: Customer-Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Enable the maintenance box to be customer-replaceable, with service center replacement as a backup for out-of-warranty devices.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime for SMBs without IT staff.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace the maintenance box without technical assistance; instructions are clear and validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure compatibility with Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user error, supports quality, and minimizes support costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMBs
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All ink bottles are uniquely keyed to Magellan; field testing shows no mis-refills possible.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability Standard
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever comes first) and define serviceability thresholds (target: customer replaceable, else service center).
requirements.Rationale: Meets SMB expectations for reliability and minimizes downtime.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are published, and serviceability standards are documented and validated in field trials.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Performance Enhancement
requirements.Description: For PDL SKUs, improve print speed to at least 25/20 ppm (from current 25/19), with PDL/PS support and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures competitive performance and compliance in the PDL market segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMBs
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKUs meet or exceed 25/20 ppm, pass PDL/PS certification, and achieve Blue Angel eco-label.

requirements.Title: SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View Portal (Non-PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Support SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal for non-PDL SKUs, including PaaS.
requirements.Rationale: Delivers enhanced manageability and services for non-PDL SMB customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKUs are compatible and validated with SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View portal features.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features for remote monitoring, diagnostics, and usage analytics to support manageability and service.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support, usage insights, and future AI/solutions enhancements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry is functional, secure, and provides actionable data; validated in pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing and printer management via the HP App.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses the need for flexibility and remote work in SMB environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing and management features are supported, tested, and documented.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan supports PaaS offerings for both PDL and non-PDL SKUs.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP's strategic goal for solutions monetization and future-proofing.
requirements.Dependencies: SMB Device Management Portal, SMB2.0 Solutions
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features are operational, and Magellan is listed as a supported device in PaaS documentation.
